name: Sanctions Evasion via Shell and Ownership Layering (50% Rule Circumvention)
description: Designated persons may retain control of assets by reducing recorded ownership below aggregation thresholds, using nominees, trusts, family members or layered holding companies. Detection depends on ownership and control analysis that looks beyond percentage holdings to influence, funding and benefit.

sources.text: OFAC, Guidance on Entities Owned by Persons Whose Property and Interests in Property Are Blocked (50 Percent Rule) (2014)
OFSI, UK Financial Sanctions General Guidance (ownership and control section)
FATF, Guidance on Beneficial Ownership of Legal Persons (2023)

exposure.rationale: Designated persons holding control via nominees, relatives and layered holding companies; exposed at onboarding and ownership screening.

indicators.name: Recent ownership reductions by a designated person around designation date
indicators.canon: Recent ownership reductions by a designated person around designation date
indicators.desc: Shareholdings are transferred or diluted shortly before or after a designation, often to relatives or associates.
indicators.ctx: Shareholdings are transferred or diluted shortly before or after a designation, often to relatives or associates.
indicators.fp: Genuine succession planning or restructuring can coincide.

indicators.name: Aggregate designated-party ownership just below the threshold
indicators.canon: Aggregate designated-party ownership just below the threshold
indicators.desc: Several designated parties each hold stakes that together reach but are individually below the threshold, or holdings sit at just under the limit.
indicators.ctx: Several designated parties each hold stakes that together reach but are individually below the threshold, or holdings sit at just under the limit.
indicators.fp: Minority stakes are routine in investments.

indicators.name: Nominee shareholders, directors or trustees with limited independent role
indicators.desc: Registered directors or shareholders appear to act for undisclosed principals, serve many entities or have no real decision-making role.
indicators.ctx: Registered officers appear to act on instruction, serve many entities or have no business connection.
indicators.fp: Professional nominees are lawful in many jurisdictions.

indicators.name: Family members or close associates acquiring assets and positions
indicators.canon: Family members or close associates acquiring assets and positions
indicators.desc: Relatives or known associates assume ownership or management of designated person's holdings.
indicators.ctx: Relatives or known associates assume ownership or management of designated person's holdings.
indicators.fp: Family businesses commonly pass to relatives.

indicators.name: Complex multi-jurisdiction holding chain without economic rationale
indicators.canon: Complex layered structure without commercial rationale
indicators.desc: Multiple tiers of entities, trusts or foundations, often across secrecy or low-transparency jurisdictions, with no evident business or tax reason.
indicators.ctx: Layers across secrecy-prone jurisdictions with trusts or foundations and no clear commercial purpose.
indicators.fp: Tax and legal planning can be legitimate.

indicators.name: Funding of a company by a designated person's connected sources
indicators.canon: Funding of a company by a designated person's connected sources
indicators.desc: Capital injections, loans or guarantees come from entities linked to a designated party.
indicators.ctx: Capital injections, loans or guarantees come from entities linked to a designated party.

indicators.name: Customer unwilling or unable to explain ownership or control
indicators.canon: Reluctance to disclose beneficial ownership or control
indicators.desc: Customer or intermediary is vague, delayed or inconsistent when asked who owns, controls or ultimately benefits from an account, entity or funds.
indicators.ctx: Evasive, delayed or inconsistent explanations about owners, controllers or purpose.
indicators.fp: Complex family businesses can take time to document.

indicators.name: Shared addresses, phone numbers or advisers with designated entities
indicators.canon: Shared addresses, phone numbers or advisers with designated entities
indicators.desc: Entities share contact details, advisers or bank accounts with designated persons.
indicators.ctx: Entities share contact details, advisers or bank accounts with designated persons.
